about: The second review of 1.24.17's rules (2026-11-13), by another agent that had seen neither the rules written nor the first review: 305 cases of its own on CONVERT's unit names (rule 1), the runaway chord line (2), the history trim (3) and the library's bonus for a named subject (4, its sums run on the rule's own function). Each case has what it expected and what it got on the build it tried. For rule 1 also how it comes out now and on 1.24.16 (tests/bench_1257.js replays them). What it found was mended (the history's short versions, the music cut, CONVERT's capitals and imperial names) or withdrawn (the library's bonus: 45 of its 95 cases wrong); see CHANGELOG 1.24.17.

known.R1: as on 1.24.16: a plain ton is the metric tonne and a plain gallon the US gallon (it asked for an error naming the choices); 'Gal', 'Ml', 'Cal' and 'degrees F' are not read as the gallon, the millilitre, the food Calorie and Fahrenheit: a name in capitals is not folded to small letters, since ML (a megalitre), MM and CAL would then be read wrongly
known.R2: a chord line under a melody is left as before and asked about (cutting it read a melody of phrases wrongly); a loop with a real ending of its own, and an AABA form of 32 bars, are no runaway and are asked about; turns are counted from the first bar after the lead-in, so a loop that starts mid-phrase may end mid-phrase
known.R3: as on 1.24.16: the picture of the question being answered is sent on its second round only when kept; a kept picture of an old turn is not sent again after a long chat
known.R4: withdrawn: the bonus is not in Lantern; the cases stay as what a ranking by a named subject must pass
